name: repo-assurance
description: Evidence-driven, read-only repository assurance for local Git repositories and GitHub live state.

interface.longDescription: Audit repository state, GitHub governance, CI/CD reliability, and local branch/worktree preservation risks using evidence-grounded read-only controls.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository in standard mode and explain the highest-priority findings.
Check this repository for CI/CD and GitHub governance gaps without changing anything.
Review stale branches, worktrees, and local-only work before recommending cleanup.
